narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac open on a knee in the south aisle. The printed column shows the fifth and the sixth. No pen is in the hand. On the almanack. The same leaf while the sand-glass runs a second time on the pulpit. The paper beside the sixth is white. Three pews ahead, a furred gown faces the chancel and does not turn.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat the hour with the almanac on his knee and made no mark.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached, and turned the sand-glass twice.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat three pews ahead, turned away, and did not speak.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in The fifth, and an empty sixth
